sections.heading: 1. Introduction
blocks: This Privacy Policy explains how Anumita Sarkar, Founder, P/ PRABHAVEE ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects personal information through this website and related professional consulting activities. This website is intended primarily for professional, business, academic, civil society, and partnership-related interactions.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
blocks: We may collect the following information when you contact us through the website or by email:
Name
Organization or affiliation
Work email address
Phone number (where provided)
Type of enquiry or engagement
Any information you choose to include in your message
In addition, our website hosting provider may automatically record technical information such as:
IP address
Browser type
Date and time of access
Pages requested
Basic server log information necessary for security and website operation

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
blocks: We use personal information to:
Respond to enquiries and requests
Communicate regarding potential engagements, partnerships, projects, speaking opportunities, research collaborations, and other professional activities
Maintain records of communications
Consider future engagement opportunities and business relationships
Improve our professional services and website operations
Comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements
We do not sell personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 4. Contact Forms and Communications
blocks: Where a website enquiry form is available, information submitted through the form is transmitted to our designated email inbox at anumita@prabhavee.org through a form processing service provider.
Information submitted through the website may be retained as part of our professional correspondence and relationship management records.

sections.heading: 5. Information Sharing
blocks: We do not disclose personal information to third parties except:
To service providers supporting website functionality, hosting, or communications;
Where required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental authority;
To protect our legal rights, safety, or property.

sections.heading: 6. Third-party service providers, individual consultants
blocks: We may engage third-party service providers, including institutions and organisations for the following reasons:
To provide services on behalf of or in collaboration;
To provide services related to services prescribed on this website.

Such providers may access personal information only to the extent necessary to perform their assigned functions and are expected to maintain its confidentiality and use it solely for the specified purposes, in accordance with applicable laws.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
blocks: We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to:
Respond to enquiries;
Manage professional relationships;
Explore future engagement opportunities;
Meet legal, regulatory, accounting, or record-keeping requirements.

sections.heading: 8. External Links and Third-Party Content
blocks: This website may contain links to external websites, publications, reports, social media platforms, or embedded content.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or policies of third-party websites. Visitors are encouraged to review the privacy policies of those websites separately.

sections.heading: 9. Data Security
blocks: We take reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.
However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
blocks: This website is intended for professional and business audiences and is not directed toward children.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: 11. Your Choices
blocks: You may contact us at any time to:
Request access to personal information you have provided;
Request correction of inaccurate information;
Request deletion of personal information, subject to legal and legitimate business requirements.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this Policy
blocks: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
blocks: For privacy-related questions or requests, please contact:
Anumita Sarkar

Website: https://www.prabhaveepfsi.org/

sections.heading: Use of Cookies
blocks: This website currently does not use cookies for advertising, behavioural profiling, visitor analytics, or marketing purposes. The website is designed to operate without tracking technologies.

sections.heading: Essential Technical Processing
blocks: Our hosting provider may automatically record certain technical information, including IP addresses, browser information, and server activity logs, to maintain website security, performance, and reliability. Such processing is necessary for the operation and protection of the website.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
blocks: Certain pages may contain links or content from third-party platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, or other external websites. When you visit those websites, their own cookies, technologies, and privacy practices may apply. We encourage users to review those policies separately.

sections.heading: Future Changes
blocks: If analytics tools, newsletters, marketing features, or additional tracking technologies are introduced in the future, this Cookie Notice will be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: General Information
blocks: The information provided on this website is for general informational and professional purposes only. Nothing on this website constitutes legal advice, investment advice, regulatory advice, professional consulting advice, or any other form of professional opinion intended to create a client relationship. Visitors should seek appropriate professional advice before acting on any information contained on this website.

blocks: While reasonable efforts are made to ensure the accuracy and relevance of information presented on this website, no representation or warranty is made regarding its completeness, accuracy, reliability, or suitability for any particular purpose.
Information may be updated, modified, or removed without notice.

sections.heading: Professional Views
blocks: Any articles, reports, publications, presentations, insights, or commentary published on this website represent the author's views at the time of publication and should not necessarily be interpreted as definitive statements of law, policy, regulation, or industry practice. The visitor is solely responsible for how they apply any strategies or frameworks discussed on the site to their own business/ work.

The nature, scope and deliverables of any professional engagement shall be determined by mutual agreement and documented in the agreed relevant proposal, engagement letter or scope of work. Publication of any service description does not constitute a commitment to undertake a specific assignment or deliver a particular outcome.

sections.heading: No Guarantee of Outcomes
blocks: Our advisory services and programmes are designed to support informed decision-making and institutional capacity building. However, outcomes depend on various factors, and no guarantee is given of regulatory compliance, certification, audit results, funding, commercial success or specific social-impact outcomes.

sections.heading: External Links
blocks: This website may contain links to external websites, publications, reports, or other resources maintained by third parties. Such links are provided solely for convenience and reference. We do not endorse, control, or accept responsibility for the content, accuracy, security, or privacy practices of external sites.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
blocks: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, we disclaim all liability arising from or related to the use of, or reliance upon, information available on this website. Users access and use this website at their own risk.

sections.heading: Restriction
blocks: All original content, materials, frameworks, methodologies and other intellectual property on this website are protected under applicable law. You are not authorised to copy or use any proprietary processes or information described in this Website. You agree to comply with all applicable laws in accessing and using this Website.

sections.heading: Confidentiality and enquiries
blocks: Visitors are advised not to submit confidential, privileged or sensitive information or documents through the website form or to the email id (anumita@prabhavee.org) provided on the website.

sections.heading: No Client Relationship
blocks: Communication through this website, including submission of enquiries, does not by itself create a client, advisory, consulting, fiduciary, or professional relationship. Any professional engagement will be subject to separate discussions and written agreement where applicable.

sections.heading: Governing Law
blocks: This website and its contents shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
